overview.text: Charles Frederick Hughes is a small business owner and a trustee on the Antelope Valley Union High School District board. He previously worked for 26 years in law enforcement. He proposes eliminating the state gas tax and reducing regulations to lower the cost of fuel, housing, and groceries. He supports ensuring law enforcement has necessary resources and expanding vocational and trade programs.
